entries.threshold: The ship you walked out of is still silent. Your squad is still aboard. Bring back their tags, or stay with them.

entries.crucible: The team leader who trained you
entries.threshold: A Hush team is boarding a ship where another slab sleeps. Get there first, and do not be seen.

entries.crucible: The officer who signed your death
entries.threshold: Your after-action report sits on a Hush relay. It says you died. Find out who wrote it.

entries.crucible: The squadmate, and what speaks through them
entries.threshold: One of your squad is broadcasting. They are asking for you by name. They should not be able to.
They sealed the dig. Go back down. There was always a second vault.
The Stratum is collapsing your dig with charges. Something down there is still breathing. Dig it out, or bury it properly.

entries.crucible: The curator, who has read too much
entries.threshold: A Stratum archive ship holds every page your name was struck from. Take them back.
Your old mentor is opening a ruin that matches my surface. Stop them, or help them finish.

entries.crucible: The newest unit of your model
entries.threshold: A foundry moon is still running. It is building something with your face. Stop it, or finish it.
A salvage crew has your predecessor in a cargo net. Take it back, or let it be sold.

entries.crucible: The source, which bears your serial number
entries.threshold: A signal written in your own code is coming from a derelict. Follow it before it follows you.
A colony believes you are their god's messenger. Tell them the truth, or let them keep you.
The consignee has been found. Deliver me, or make sure they never sign for me.
Your old rig is impounded at a Hush checkpoint, and the manifest still carries my name. Get it back before they read it.

entries.crucible: What was in the other crate
entries.threshold: A Lanes freighter went silent on your old route. Its logs say it carried a crate like mine.

entries.crucible: The tribunal, all wearing one face
entries.threshold: The Lanes are holding a hearing about the missing cargo. Speak for yourself, or let me speak for you.
A shrine of your order went dark three days ago. They prayed to a different book. Find out what answered.
Raiders hold the Choir's reliquary moon. They are breaking open the saints. Stop them, or see what is inside.
A pilgrim road crosses a dead world, every step pointing to the Last Altar. Walk it before the light fails.
The Choir's oldest hymn is a set of coordinates. Sing it to a navigation core.

entries.crucible: Whichever one you did not choose
entries.threshold: Your buyer is aboard this station. So is the thief. Only one of them leaves.

entries.crucible: The thief, wearing something of mine
entries.threshold: The thief came back for it, with friends. Hold the shop.
A forger can make a second TOME good enough to fool your buyer. Steal what she needs. Do not look at what it is.

entries.crucible: The buyer, who already holds a slab
entries.threshold: The buyer wants to meet face to face about the debt. Bring nothing. I will be listening.
